help.text:
Guide to {bot}:
• To talk to me, say "{bot}" and then write your message, or reply to my message.
• "{bot} dollar" or /dollar — live dollar rate
• "{bot} currency" or /currency — world currencies in dollars and {currency}
• "{bot} gold" or /gold — gold and coin prices
• "{bot} crypto" or /crypto — crypto prices
• "{bot} time" or /time — time and date in {city}
• "{bot} weather <city>" or /weather <city> — weather in a city
• "{bot} price <currency>" or /price <currency> — price of one currency
• "{bot} forget me" or /forget — clear your memory and history
• "{bot} image <description>" — make an image (or: "{bot} make an image of <description>")
• Edit a photo — send a photo and tell me what to do with it (for example: "make this cartoonish") or reply to a photo
• "{bot} fortune" or /faal — Hafez fortune
• "{bot} news" or /news — today's news
• "{bot} prayer <city>" or /prayer <city> — prayer times
• "{bot} calculate <expression>" or /calc <expression> — calculator
• "{bot} dice" or /dice — roll a die
• "{bot} coin" or /coin — heads or tails
• "{bot} joke" or /joke — tell me a joke
• "{bot} download <link>" or /download <link> — download a file (song, video...) from a link and send it in the chat (max 45 MB)
• "{bot} quota" or /quota — your daily message quota
• "{bot} id" or /id — your numeric ID

jokes:
The Wi-Fi went down, and its owner said: "The internet is gone!"
The Wi-Fi said: "No, I just went for a cup of tea!"

Teacher: "Why didn't you come to school yesterday?"
Student: "I was sick!"
Teacher: "Then why did you come today?"
Student: "Because Mom said if I skip today too, I'm not sick anymore!"

My phone is so smart that when I want to sleep, it turns itself off!
But I'm smarter: I turn it back on!

Mom: "Why is your room a mess?"
Me: "Because I'm looking for something!"
Mom: "What?"
Me: "Order!"

Someone goes to the doctor and says: "Doctor, whenever I laugh, my stomach hurts!"
The doctor says: "Then don't laugh!"
He says: "But Doctor, I came to you to laugh!"

Why do fish never fight?
Because their mouths are full of water and they can't talk!

A cat goes to the doctor and says: "Doctor, I have 9 lives but I'm always tired!"
The doctor says: "Because you have 9 lives, you get tired 9 times as much!"

One day a mirror breaks, and its owner says: "Oh no, 7 years of bad luck!"
The mirror says: "No, you just have to buy a new mirror for 7 years!"

One day a light bulb goes to the electrician and says: "I keep burning out!"
The electrician says: "Because your voltage is too high!"
The bulb says: "No, because my owner always leaves me on!"

A fridge door stays open, and its owner says: "Close the door!"
The fridge says: "Why? I'm getting some fresh air!"

Someone says to a friend: "I bought a car that doesn't use any gas!"
The friend says: "Really?"
He says: "Yes, because I haven't bought it yet!"

Math teacher: "If you have 5 apples and give 2 to your friend, what is left?"
Student: "3 apples and a friend who won't give me apples anymore!"

A book says to its owner: "Read me!"
The owner says: "I don't feel like it!"
The book says: "Then why did you buy me?"
The owner says: "Because Mom told me to!"

Someone goes to the doctor and says: "Doctor, I have amnesia!"
The doctor says: "Since when?"
He says: "Since when what?"

Why is a computer never hungry?
Because it always has a mouse... but it doesn't eat the mouse, it works with it!
